_doc: Canonical hook WIRING manifest. Hook LOGIC lives beside this file (scripts/md payloads — the canon; per-harness copies are dead). harness-sync.sh renders this into each harness's dialect via build_hooks_obj(<harness>, <scope>): org scope -> <repos>/.claude/settings.json#hooks (Claude), <repos>/.codex/hooks.json (Codex), tools/droid/hooks.json -> ~/.factory/hooks.json (Droid); app scope -> <app>/.claude/settings.json#hooks stamped block (Claude only — no other harness has functioning app-scope hooks); machine scope -> ~/.grok/hooks/00-ac.json (Grok only: it discards passive-event stdout, so only PreToolUse guards + fire-and-forget loggers function there; its context stack is the generated ~/.grok/AGENTS.md rules projection instead). Pi has no declarative hooks (TS extensions only) — skipped with a warning. Placeholders: {HOOKS} = this dir via $HOME/Repos path · {HOME} = $HOME literal. Event names are shared verbatim by Claude/Codex/Droid/Grok. Per-harness `command` objects express capability-gated content variants when needed. `timeout` (seconds) passes through to the rendered hook — REQUIRED on blocking hooks rendered for grok (fail-open, 5s default there). NOTE: regenerating Codex's hooks.json invalidates its trusted_hash — re-trust once via /hooks in the Codex TUI.

wiring._doc: Emits a plain-stdout <memory-recall> block — injected as context by claude, codex, and droid (all three inject UserPromptSubmit stdout; verified 2026-07-12). Grok discards passive stdout — its recall path is the rules-digest floor + qmd MCP pull. HOT-LANE: the script queries MEMORY_LOBES (memory, neometa-memory, content-memory, wiki) + per-app lobes on EVERY prompt — adding/removing a lobe changes per-prompt latency and the recall surface fleet-wide; the wiki lobe means wiki synthesis pages are auto-injected context (bead org-yp4).
Full push variant everywhere since codex/droid gained stdout injection (2026-07-12; previously delegation-reminder.manual-recall.md — that payload now sources the Grok rules projection).

Grok aliases Bash -> run_terminal_command in matchers; the script emits Grok's deny dialect when GROK_HOOK_EVENT is set. Explicit timeout because Grok defaults to 5s and fails open. `app` scope added 2026-07-30 (bd-klyfr): org reaches only <repos>-rooted Claude sessions and machine reaches only Grok, so without `app` this guard was DEAD in every Claude app session — which is where nearly all work happens.

Advisory reminder of the skill-diet promotion ladder + no-net-growth gate on Edit/Write to a skills/**/SKILL.md spine file (plan 2026-07-19-2338-skill-doctrine-diet-promotion-governance.md, D4/W2a). PreToolUse cannot inject context here (exit code + stderr only, verified against am-edit-guard.py) — signals via exit 2 + stderr, once per session (session-scoped flag file keyed on CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, falling back to a daily key), never blocks the edit. `machine` scope (mirroring trauma-guard) is required for this to actually reach Grok — its build_hooks_obj call only reads scope=machine (render_hooks_grok), so scope:[org] alone would silently drop grok despite being listed in harnesses. `app` scope added 2026-07-30 (bd-klyfr) and is the one that matters most: registry SKILL.md files are symlinked into every app, so a spine edit almost always happens in an APP session — where org (repos-rooted only) and machine (grok only) both miss it. Measured dead 7+ days; /tmp/skill-edit-guard/ had never been created. Explicit timeout because Grok defaults to 5s and fails open.
